papers.title: Motion-corrected Noise2Noise denoising for structural analysis of cells and tissues with (cryo-)FIB/SEM
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation (Cryo-)FIB/SEM enables three-dimensional (3D) ultrastructural analysis of cells and tissues at nanoscale resolution. However, its characteristically low signal-to-noise ratio severely hinders interpretation of the volume data. Noise2Noise has emerged as a state-of-the-art denoising paradigm with outstanding performance in 3D electron microscopy -particularly cryo-ET- but its direct application to (cryo-)FIB/SEM remains unfeasible due to the inherent acquisition workflows. Results A method to enable Noise2Noise denoising in (cryo-)FIB/SEM is introduced. The input volume is split into even and odd slices followed by the application of motion correction methods to estimate and compensate for the structural differences between the two subvolumes. The resulting motion-corrected subvolumes are then used to train the Noise2Noise model, which is ultimately applied to denoise the original volume. Representative (cryo-)FIB/SEM volumes have been used to validate the method and to demonstrate the critical importance of the motion correction stage for volumes with a slice thickness greater than 10 nm. Availability and Implementation Code is available at https://github.com/microscopy-processing/N2N-REO and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22303478
papers.abstract:
MOTIVATION: (Cryo-)FIB/SEM enables three-dimensional (3D) ultrastructural analysis of cells and tissues at nanoscale resolution. However, its characteristically low signal-to-noise ratio severely hinders interpretation of the volume data. Noise2Noise has emerged as a state-of-the-art denoising paradigm with outstanding performance in 3D electron microscopy -particularly cryo-ET- but its direct application to (cryo-)FIB/SEM remains unfeasible due to the inherent acquisition workflows.

RESULTS: A method to enable Noise2Noise denoising in (cryo-)FIB/SEM is introduced. The input volume is split into even and odd slices followed by the application of motion correction methods to estimate and compensate for the structural differences between the two subvolumes. The resulting motion-corrected subvolumes are then used to train the Noise2Noise model, which is ultimately applied to denoise the original volume. Representative (cryo-)FIB/SEM volumes have been used to validate the method and to demonstrate the critical importance of the motion correction stage for volumes with a slice thickness greater than 10 nm.

papers.llm_title_zh: 经过运动校正的噪声去除技术：适用于利用（冷冻）FIB/SEM对细胞及组织进行结构分析时的噪声处理方法。
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 经过运动校正的噪声去除技术：适用于利用（冷冻）FIB/SEM对细胞及组织进行结构分析时的噪声处理方法。 / Motion-corrected Noise2Noise denoising for structural analysis of cells and tissues with (cryo-)FIB/SEM
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 动机：(冷冻)纤维显微镜与扫描电子显微镜相结合的技术能够以纳米级分辨率对细胞及组织进行三维超微结构分析。
llm_highlights_zh: 然而，其特有的低信噪比严重阻碍了对这些体积数据的解读。
噪声去除技术已成为一种先进的去噪方法，在三维电子显微镜领域，尤其是在冷冻电镜技术中，表现极为出色。然而，由于其固有的数据采集流程，这种技术直接应用于冷冻场发射扫描电镜仍存在实际操作上的困难。
结果：本文介绍了一种可在（冷冻）场发射扫描电子显微镜中实现Noise2Noise去噪的方法。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：  
(cryo-)FIB/SEM技术能够以纳米级分辨率对细胞和组织进行三维超微结构分析，但其较低的信噪比严重影响了体积数据的解析效果。Noise2Noise作为一种先进的去噪方法，在三维电子显微镜领域尤其是cryo-ET中表现出色，但由于(cryo-)FIB/SEM的采集流程限制，直接将其应用于该技术目前仍存在可行性障碍。  
本研究提出了一种在(cryo-)FIB/SEM中应用Noise2Noise去噪的方法：首先将原始体积数据分割为偶数层和奇数层，然后通过运动校正技术消除这两部分数据之间的结构差异；随后利用这些经过校正的数据训练Noise2Noise模型，并最终用该模型对原始体积数据进行去噪处理。实验结果表明，该方法对于切片厚度超过10纳米的样本而言尤为有效，且运动校正步骤在去噪过程中起着至关重要的作用。  
相关代码及资源可访问以下链接：  
https://github.com/microscopy-processing/N2N-REO  
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22303478

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 动机：(冷冻)纤维显微镜与扫描电子显微镜相结合的技术能够以纳米级分辨率对细胞及组织进行三维超微结构分析。
llm_highlights_zh: 然而，其特有的低信噪比严重阻碍了对这些体积数据的解读。
噪声去除技术已成为一种先进的去噪方法，在三维电子显微镜领域，尤其是在冷冻电镜技术中，表现极为出色。然而，由于其固有的数据采集流程，这种技术直接应用于冷冻场发射扫描电镜仍存在实际操作上的困难。
结果：本文介绍了一种可在（冷冻）场发射扫描电子显微镜中实现Noise2Noise去噪的方法。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：  
(cryo-)FIB/SEM技术能够以纳米级分辨率对细胞和组织进行三维超微结构分析，但其较低的信噪比严重影响了体积数据的解析效果。Noise2Noise作为一种先进的去噪方法，在三维电子显微镜领域尤其是cryo-ET中表现出色，但由于(cryo-)FIB/SEM的采集流程限制，直接将其应用于该技术目前仍存在可行性障碍。  
本研究提出了一种在(cryo-)FIB/SEM中应用Noise2Noise去噪的方法：首先将原始体积数据分割为偶数层和奇数层，然后通过运动校正技术消除这两部分数据之间的结构差异；随后利用这些经过校正的数据训练Noise2Noise模型，并最终用该模型对原始体积数据进行去噪处理。实验结果表明，该方法对于切片厚度超过10纳米的样本而言尤为有效，且运动校正步骤在去噪过程中起着至关重要的作用。  
相关代码及资源可访问以下链接：  
https://github.com/microscopy-processing/N2N-REO  
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22303478

all_papers.primary_summary_raw:
MOTIVATION: (Cryo-)FIB/SEM enables three-dimensional (3D) ultrastructural analysis of cells and tissues at nanoscale resolution. However, its characteristically low signal-to-noise ratio severely hinders interpretation of the volume data. Noise2Noise has emerged as a state-of-the-art denoising paradigm with outstanding performance in 3D electron microscopy -particularly cryo-ET- but its direct application to (cryo-)FIB/SEM remains unfeasible due to the inherent acquisition workflows.

RESULTS: A method to enable Noise2Noise denoising in (cryo-)FIB/SEM is introduced. The input volume is split into even and odd slices followed by the application of motion correction methods to estimate and compensate for the structural differences between the two subvolumes. The resulting motion-corrected subvolumes are then used to train the Noise2Noise model, which is ultimately applied to denoise the original volume. Representative (cryo-)FIB/SEM volumes have been used to validate the method and to demonstrate the critical importance of the motion correction stage for volumes with a slice thickness greater than 10 nm.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code is available at https://github.com/microscopy-processing/N2N-REO and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22303478.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
